name: Sonic Analysis (on-device)
description: On-device audio analysis. Extracts measurement-based features (energy, loudness, brightness, spectral characteristics, rhythmic regularity) via a torch-accelerated pipeline, and soft perceptual features (danceability, valence, arousal, instrumentalness, acousticness) via Microsoft CLAP zero-shot classification. First-time activation downloads ~800MB of model weights (CLAP + GPT2 text encoder) to the local HuggingFace cache. All components MIT or Apache 2.0.
